# The SEO Audit Factory

> Free SEO audits that crawl real pages, plus five personalized ways to save
> money on marketing and free marketing content powered by the Plunder & Riffle
> MCP. Operated by Plunder & Riffle. No signup, no credit card. Estimates are
> illustrative; we never fake data or promise rankings or AI citations.

## Pages

- [Home / Free Audit](/#/): Run a real audit: technical SEO, on-page content, AI search readiness (GEO/AEO), local SEO and performance checks with evidence for every finding.
- [Knowledge Center](/#/learn): 18 practical guides on SEO, AI search, local SEO, performance and marketing economics.
- [SEO Glossary](/#/glossary): Plain-English definitions of the terms business owners actually ask about.
- [Free SEO Resources](/#/resources): Curated free tools from primary sources (Google Search Central, web.dev, schema.org, llmstxt.org).
- [Offers & Deals](/#/offers): The one-page toolbox hub (Agent 37, Whop, Plunder & Riffle) - optional, tactfully presented; the audit stays free.
- [About & Methodology](/#/about): How the audit engine works, its limits, privacy practices and contact information.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Audit findings are based on real crawler requests to the audited site at audit time; performance figures are lab-style, single-location measurements, not Google field data.
- Savings figures are illustrative scenarios with editable assumptions, not quotes or guarantees.
- The audit methodology is adapted from the MIT-licensed claude-seo project by Agrici Daniel.
- Content generation runs through the Plunder & Riffle MCP (bot.plunderandriffle.com/api/mcp).
- Every completed audit includes one complimentary "/BEFORE" generation built from the audited site (P&R create_before_pitch; a clearly-labeled built-in engine substitutes when no operator API key is configured).
